title: jmap-server: ConditionalBackend, SetScope, SetSupport and opt-in attach API
description:
Design: docs/design/conditional.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: C2. Crates: jmap-server. Size: M.

Implement docs/design/conditional.md §5.1 and §6 (conditional-02 §4, §6.1, §6.2, §9.1). In crate-jmap-server: trait ConditionalBackend: JmapBackend with REQUIRED begin_set(caller, SetScopeRequest) -> Result<Box<dyn SetScope>, BeginSetError<E>> (no default, spec-method-defaults rule) and hidden_properties (default Ok(empty), fail-open permission hook); SetScope (commit/rollback, drop rolls back); SetScopeRequest, SetMode {Isolated, Atomic}, BeginSetError, CommitError {Rejected(Vec<DeferredFailure>), Other}, DeferredFailure, SetOp {Create, Update, Destroy, Restore}; SET_SCOPE task_local + current_set_scope(); serialized_writes_scope(request) helper (refuses Atomic, no-op Isolated, rustdoc states the only condition it is correct under). Decision 1 (docs/design/DECISIONS.md): opt-in, non-breaking: SetSupport<C> { data_type, [SERVER_SET, CLIENT_SETTABLE], Arc<dyn DynConditional<C>> } with SetSupport::new::<O: SetObject, B: ConditionalBackend>(Arc<B>); Dispatcher::attach_set_support(method, support) -> Result (errors on unregistered or non-/set method); Dispatcher::register of a method drops its SetSupport. No change to JmapHandler, ClosureHandler or any register fn. CallContext gains pub atomic: bool; HandlerOutput gains non-wire unreadable map + with_unreadable(). All #[non_exhaustive] where listed in §6. Acceptance: unit tests for attach/register-drops/unregistered error, scope drop rolls back with a test SetScope; rustdoc on every hook states the contract text from §6; public-api/jmap-server.txt additions only; existing tests unchanged.
